correctness.rationale: For \(n\ge2\), the rank-one objective is \(A^2/S\). Its derivative factors as \(A(2SA'-S'A)/S^2\). With \(S\) squarefree, generic \(A\) squarefree and coprime to \(S\), the critical polynomial \(W\) avoids cuts and poles. Cancellation of the highest coefficient leaves \(\deg W=3n-2\) and a nonvanishing derivative at infinity. The independent two-jet conditions \(W=W'=0\) imply generic simple finite roots. Subtracting \(n\) simple cut-ramification points from \(4n-2\) total Riemann--Hurwitz ramification gives the same count. Exact finite-field checks for \(n\le20\) corroborate but do not prove the general formula.

value.rationale: This computes the natural GD invariant for an unbounded family of embedded curves, separating exactly \(3n-2\) non-cut stationary points from \(n\) unavoidable cut-locus stationary roots. It refines an existing ED count by a geometric distinction central to the motivating Grassmann-distance literature.
